  .exit('clean', ctx => ctx.steps.audit.deficits.length === 0)
  .exit('roundsExhausted');

const tracker = linear.store({
  apiKey: H.env('LINEAR_API_KEY'),
  team: 'ENG',
  workflow: ['Backlog', 'In Progress', 'Done', 'Canceled'],
});

const bugLane = H.lane('bugs', bugKind)
  .handler(buildAndAudit, { exits: { clean: Done, roundsExhausted: NeedsTriage }, params: { rounds: 3 } })
  .store(tracker, {
    states: { Ready: 'Backlog', NeedsTriage: 'Backlog', Done: 'Done', Cancelled: 'Canceled' },
    inFlight: 'In Progress',
  })
  .retry({ maxAttempts: 2, backoff: 'exponential', initialDelayMs: 600_000, exhausted: NeedsTriage })
  .on(H.cancel, { enter: Cancelled })
  .supply(linear.issues({ apiKey: H.env('LINEAR_API_KEY'), team: 'ENG', labels: ['bug'] }), (issue, to) =>
    to.create({ ref: issue.identifier, title: issue.title, description: issue.description }),
  )
  .supply(folder.files({ path: './bugs', glob: '*.md' }), (file, to) =>
    to.create({ ref: file.path, title: file.name, description: file.body }),
  )
  .supply(H.operator);

const featureLane = H.lane('features', featureKind)
  .handler(buildAndAudit, { exits: { clean: Done, roundsExhausted: NeedsTriage }, params: { rounds: 5 } })
  .store(tracker, {
    states: { Ready: 'Backlog', NeedsTriage: 'Backlog', Done: 'Done', Cancelled: 'Canceled' },
    inFlight: 'In Progress',
  })
  .retry({ maxAttempts: 2, backoff: 'exponential', initialDelayMs: 600_000, exhausted: NeedsTriage })
  .on(H.cancel, { enter: Cancelled })
  .supply(linear.issues({ apiKey: H.env('LINEAR_API_KEY'), team: 'ENG', labels: ['feature'] }), (issue, to) =>
    to.create({ ref: issue.identifier, title: issue.title, description: issue.description }),

  .supply(H.operator);

import { z } from 'zod';
import { H } from 'harness-dsl';
import { sqlite } from 'harness-dsl/sqlite';
import { jsonl } from 'harness-dsl/jsonl';
import { pgvector } from 'harness-dsl/pgvector';
import { voyage } from 'harness-dsl/voyage';
import { anthropic } from 'harness-dsl/anthropic';
import { claudeCode } from 'harness-dsl/claude-code';
import { local } from 'harness-dsl/local';
import { markdown } from 'harness-dsl/markdown';

const quota = sqlite.quota('research-quota', { path: './state/quota.sqlite' });
const apiAccount = anthropic.account('research-api', { apiKey: H.env('ANTHROPIC_API_KEY'), quota });
const researchPool = H.pool('research-api').accounts(apiAccount);

const haiku = anthropic.model('haiku', { id: 'claude-haiku-4-5' });
const opus = anthropic.model('opus', { id: 'claude-opus-4-1' });
const sonnet = anthropic.model('sonnet', { id: 'claude-sonnet-4-5' });

const Topic = z.object({ topic: z.string(), tags: z.array(z.string()) });

const Open = H.state('Open', 'pending');
const Delivered = H.terminal('Delivered', 'success');
const Parked = H.terminal('Parked', 'neutral');
const CancelledByOperator = H.terminal('CancelledByOperator', 'neutral');
const Failed = H.terminal('Failed', 'failure');

const topicKind = H.kind('Topic')
  .attributes(Topic)
  .states(Open, Delivered, Parked, CancelledByOperator, Failed)
  .key(attrs => attrs.topic)
  .initial(Open);

const extractorRole = H.role('extractor').intents('search', 'browse', 'read').instructions('Find sources and extract sourced claims.');
const synthesizerRole = H.role('synthesizer')
  .intents('read', 'record')
  .instructions('Write a sourced report. Record findings and source lessons that will hold next time.');

const extractor = H.seat('extractor')
  .role(extractorRole)
  .model(haiku)
  .pool(researchPool)
  .output(z.object({ sources: z.array(z.object({ url: z.string(), finding: z.string() })) }));

const synthesizerModel = H.policy.model('synthesizer-model', [opus, sonnet], ctx => {
  const opusRecord = ctx.metrics.rate(citationPass, { seat: ctx.seat, model: opus, window: { lastDays: 30 } });
  const sonnetRecord = ctx.metrics.rate(citationPass, { seat: ctx.seat, model: sonnet, window: { lastDays: 30 } });
  if (opusRecord.samples < 10) return opus;
  if (sonnetRecord.samples < 10) return sonnet;
  return opusRecord.rate >= sonnetRecord.rate ? opus : sonnet;
});

const synthesizer = H.seat('synthesizer')
  .role(synthesizerRole)
  .model(synthesizerModel)
  .pool(researchPool)
  .output(z.object({ report: z.string(), citations: z.array(z.string()) }));

const extractBatch = extractor.batch();

const localRunner = local.runner('local').slots(2);
const citationCheck = H.command('citation-check')
  .input(z.object({ report: z.string(), citations: z.array(z.string()) }))
  .argv(input => ['./bin/check-citations', '--report', input.report, ...input.citations])
  .runner(localRunner);

const research = H.flow('research')
  .input(Topic)
  .job('extract', extractBatch, ctx =>
    Array.from({ length: 20 }, (_, index) => ({
      task: `Search angle ${index + 1} of 20 on "${ctx.unit.attributes.topic}": find sources and extract sourced claims.`,
      skills: ['search'],
    })),
  )
  .exit('parked', ctx => ctx.steps.extract.flatMap(result => result.sources).length < 5)
  .step('synthesize', synthesizer, ctx => ({
    task: `Write a sourced report on "${ctx.unit.attributes.topic}" from these extracts:\n${JSON.stringify(ctx.steps.extract)}`,
  }))
  .step('citations', citationCheck, ctx => ({
    report: ctx.steps.synthesize.report,
    citations: ctx.steps.synthesize.citations,
  }))
  .exit('delivered');

const topicLane = H.lane('topics', topicKind)
  .handler(research, { exits: { parked: Parked, delivered: Delivered } })
  .store(sqlite.store({ path: './state/topics.sqlite' }))
  .retry({ maxAttempts: 2, backoff: 'exponential', initialDelayMs: 300_000, exhausted: Failed })
  .ceiling({ maxUsd: 3, onExceed: 'fail' })
  .on(H.cancel, { enter: CancelledByOperator })
  .supply(H.operator)
  .supply(
    sqlite.scan('recurring-topics', {
      path: './state/topics.sqlite',
      kind: 'Topic',
      schedule: H.clock('weekly-reopen').at('06:00', { on: 'mon', tz: 'UTC' }),
    }),
    (stored, to) => {
      const topic = Topic.parse(stored.attributes);
      return topic.tags.includes('recurring') ? to.create(topic) : to.skip();
    },
  );

const citationPass = H.metric('citation-pass', H.when.step(topicLane, 'citations')).samples(event => [
  { hit: event.ok, seat: synthesizer, model: event.seats.synthesize?.model },
]);

const researchSpend = H.metric('research-spend', H.when.invocation({ lanes: [topicLane] })).amounts(event => [
  { amount: event.costUsd, seat: event.seat, model: event.model },
]);

const deliveredAttemptCost = H.metric('delivered-attempt-cost', H.when.transition(topicLane, { to: Delivered })).amounts(
  event => (event.attempt ? [{ amount: event.attempt.costUsd }] : []),
);

const findings = H.journal('report-findings', H.memory('report-findings', 'experience'))
  .store(
    pgvector.memoryStore({
      url: H.env('FINDINGS_DATABASE_URL'),
      table: 'findings',
      embedder: voyage.embedder('findings-embedder', { id: 'voyage-3', apiKey: H.env('VOYAGE_API_KEY') }),
    }),
  )
  .recall({ by: 'similarity', limit: 6 })
  .readBy(synthesizerRole)
  .recordedBy(synthesizerRole);

const sourceExperience = H.journal('source-experience', H.memory('source-experience', 'experience'))
  .store(jsonl.memoryStore({ path: './memory/sources.jsonl' }))
  .recall({ by: 'specificity', limit: 8 })
  .readBy(extractorRole, synthesizerRole)
  .recordedBy(synthesizerRole);

const scheduler = H.scheduler('research')
  .standard(topicLane)
  .wip(topicLane, 3)
  .admit(topicLane, ctx => {
    const spentToday = ctx.metrics.total(researchSpend, { window: { calendar: 'day', tz: 'UTC' } });
    const delivered = ctx.metrics.total(deliveredAttemptCost, { window: { lastDays: 30 } });
    const projected = delivered.samples === 0 ? 3 : delivered.total / delivered.samples;
    return spentToday.total + projected <= 40;
  });

const supervisor = claudeCode.supervisor('research-operator', {
  port: H.slot.port(0),
  grants: [
    H.ops.workRead,
    H.ops.workCreate,
    H.ops.workCancel,
    H.ops.attemptsRecover,
    H.ops.memoryRead,
    H.ops.memoryWrite,
    H.ops.telemetryRead,
  ],
});

export default H.harness('research-pipeline')
  .ledger(sqlite.ledger({ path: './state/ledger.sqlite' }))
  .lanes(topicLane)
  .journals(findings, sourceExperience)
  .metrics(citationPass, researchSpend, deliveredAttemptCost)
  .scheduler(scheduler)
  .clients(supervisor)
  .observers(markdown.board({ path: './BOARD.md' }), markdown.telemetry({ path: './TELEMETRY.md' }));

type DraftAttrs = z.infer<typeof Draft>;

const NeedsAttention = H.state('NeedsAttention', 'waiting');

const Returned = H.terminal('Returned', 'neutral');

const editorRole = H.role('editor');

  seats.find(assignment => assignment.seat.name === seat.name)?.model;

const reviewerModel = (name: string, incumbent: Model, replacement: Model, rival: () => SeatRef): ModelPolicy =>
  H.policy.model(name, [incumbent, replacement], ctx => {
    const mine = ctx.metrics.rate(editorActedOn, { seat: ctx.seat, model: incumbent });
    const theirs = ctx.metrics.rate(editorActedOn, { seat: rival() });
    return mine.samples >= 50 && theirs.samples >= 50 && mine.rate < theirs.rate ? replacement : incumbent;
  });

  .role(reviewerRole)
  .model(reviewerModel('reviewer-a-model', opus, challenger, (): SeatRef => reviewerB))
  .pool(reviewPool)
  .output(z.object({ points: z.array(z.string()) }));

const reviewerB = H.seat('reviewer-b')
  .role(reviewerRole)
  .model(reviewerModel('reviewer-b-model', sonnet, challenger, (): SeatRef => reviewerA))

  }),

const categories = ['billing', 'shipping', 'refunds', 'account'] as const satisfies readonly string[];
const category = H.facet('category');
const categoryResources = new Map<string, Resource>(categories.map((name): [string, Resource] => [name, H.resource(`category-${name}`)]));
function resourcesFor(name: string): Resource[] {
  const found = categoryResources.get(name);
  return found === undefined ? [] : [found];
}

const tasteKind = H.memory('taste', 'taste');
const experienceKind = H.memory('experience', 'experience');

const classifierRole = H.role('classifier').intents('read').instructions('Classify the conversation into exactly one category.');
const drafterRole = H.role('drafter').intents('read').instructions('Draft the reply in the house tone, citing policy where it applies.');
const reviewerRole = H.role('reviewer').intents('read', 'record').instructions('Approve, edit or reject the drafted reply.');

  .store(jsonl.memoryStore({ path: './.harness/taste.jsonl' }))
  .recall({ by: 'specificity', limit: 10 })
  .readBy(drafterRole)
  .recordedBy(reviewerRole);

const experienceJournal = H.journal('support-experience', experienceKind)
  .store(jsonl.memoryStore({ path: './.harness/experience.jsonl' }))
  .recall({ by: 'specificity', limit: 10 })
  .readBy(drafterRole)
  .recordedBy(reviewerRole);

const conversationAttrs = z.object({
  ticketId: z.string(),
  subject: z.string(),
  customerEmail: z.string(),
  lastMessage: z.string(),
  priority: z.enum(['low', 'normal', 'high', 'urgent']),
  slaDeadline: z.string(),
});
type ConversationAttrs = z.infer<typeof conversationAttrs>;

const fresh = H.state('New', 'pending');
const sent = H.terminal('Sent', 'success');
const closedByCustomer = H.terminal('ClosedByCustomer', 'neutral');
const escalated = H.terminal('Escalated', 'failure');

const conversation = H.kind('Conversation')
  .attributes(conversationAttrs)
  .states(fresh, sent, closedByCustomer, escalated)
  .key(a => a.ticketId)
  .initial(fresh);

const customerReplied = H.signal('customer-replied').payload(z.object({ message: z.string() }));
const customerClosed = H.signal('customer-closed');
const escalate = H.signal('escalate');

const approval = H.halt('reply-approval').decision(z.object({ approved: z.boolean(), edited: z.string().optional() }));
const costHalt = H.halt('cost-ceiling').decision(H.ceilingDecision);

const approvalRate = H.metric('approval', H.when.decision(conversation, approval)).samples(event =>
  event.resolvedBy !== 'human'
    ? []
    : event.seats.map(assignment => ({
        hit: event.decision.approved,
        facets: event.facets,
        seat: assignment.seat,
        model: assignment.model,
      })));

const safeCategory = H.policy.halt('safe-category-skips-approval', conversation, approval).decide(ctx => {
  const record = ctx.metrics.rate(approvalRate, { facets: ctx.facets });
  return record.samples >= 200 && record.hits === record.samples ? { approved: true } : undefined;
});

  .role(classifierRole)
  .model(haiku)
  .pool(pool)
  .output(z.object({ category: z.enum(categories) }));

  .role(drafterRole)
  .model(sonnet)
  .pool(pool)
  .output(z.object({ reply: z.string() }));

  .input(z.object({ ticketId: z.string(), body: z.string() }))
  .argv(input => ['helpdesk', 'reply', input.ticketId, input.body])
  .runner(runner);

  .input(conversationAttrs)
  .step('classify', classifierSeat, ctx => ({ task: `Classify: ${ctx.unit.attributes.subject}\n\n${ctx.unit.attributes.lastMessage}` }))
  .step('draft', drafterSeat, ctx => ({

    resources: resourcesFor(ctx.steps.classify.category),

const slaHours = { low: 48, normal: 24, high: 8, urgent: 2 };

function routeTicket(event: ZendeskEvent, to: Router<ConversationAttrs>): Route {
  if (event.status === 'solved' || event.status === 'closed') return to.signal(customerClosed, event.ticketId, {});
  if (event.type === 'created') {
    return to.create({
      ticketId: event.ticketId,
      subject: event.subject,
      customerEmail: event.customerEmail,
      lastMessage: event.message,
      priority: event.priority,
      slaDeadline: new Date(event.createdAt.getTime() + slaHours[event.priority] * 3600000).toISOString(),
    });
  }
  if (event.type === 'replied') return to.signal(customerReplied, event.ticketId, { message: event.message });
  return to.skip();

  .runner(runner);

const analystSeat = H.seat('eval-analyst').role(analystRole).model(sonnet).pool(pool);

const evalFlow = H.flow('eval-run')
  .input(evalAttrs)
  .step('prepare', prepare, ctx => ({ model: ctx.unit.attributes.model, suite: ctx.unit.attributes.suite }), { afterCrash: 'rerun' })
  .job('gpu', gpuEval, ctx => ({ checkpoint: ctx.steps.prepare.checkpoint, suite: ctx.unit.attributes.suite }))
  .step('score', score, ctx => ({ resultsPath: ctx.steps.gpu.resultsPath }), { afterCrash: 'rerun' })
  .step('summarize', analystSeat, ctx => ({ task: `Summarise ${ctx.unit.attributes.name}: score ${ctx.steps.score.score}\n${ctx.steps.score.report}` }))
  .exit('scored');

const evals = H.lane('evals', evalRun)
  .supply(H.operator)
  .handler(evalFlow, { exits: { scored: evalScored } })
  .store(harnessStore)
  .retry({ maxAttempts: 2, backoff: 'exponential', initialDelayMs: 600000, exhausted: evalFailed })
  .on(H.cancel, { enter: evalDropped });

const migrationAttrs = z.object({ database: databaseName, sequence: z.number(), path: z.string() });

const migrationQueued = H.state('Queued', 'pending');
const heldByPredecessor = H.state('HeldByPredecessor', 'waiting');
const migrationApplied = H.terminal('Applied', 'success');
const migrationFailed = H.terminal('Failed', 'failure');
const migrationDropped = H.terminal('Dropped', 'neutral');

const migrationKey = (database: string, sequence: number): string => `${database}-${String(sequence).padStart(4, '0')}`;

const migration = H.kind('Migration')
  .attributes(migrationAttrs)
  .states(migrationQueued, heldByPredecessor, migrationApplied, migrationFailed, migrationDropped)
  .key(a => migrationKey(a.database, a.sequence))
  .initial(migrationQueued);

const applyMigration = H.command('apply-migration')
  .input(z.object({ database: z.string(), path: z.string() }))
  .argv(input => ['migrate', '--database', input.database, input.path])
  .runner(dbOps);

const migrationFlow = H.flow('migration')
  .input(migrationAttrs)
  .step('apply', applyMigration, ctx => ({ database: ctx.unit.attributes.database, path: ctx.unit.attributes.path }), { afterCrash: 'park' })
  .exit('applied');

const migrations = H.lane('migrations', migration)
  .supply(folder.files({ path: './migrations', glob: '*/*.sql' }), (file, to) => {
    const match = /([a-z]+)\/(\d{4})-[^/]+\.sql$/.exec(file.path);
    if (match === null) return to.skip();
    const database = databaseName.safeParse(match[1]);
    if (!database.success) return to.skip();
    return to.create({ database: database.data, sequence: Number(match[2]), path: file.path });
  })
  .handler(migrationFlow, { exits: { applied: migrationApplied } })
  .store(harnessStore)
  .retry({ maxAttempts: 1, exhausted: migrationFailed })
  .lease(unit => ({ resource: databases[unit.attributes.database], mode: 'exclusive' }))
  .after({
    key: a => (a.sequence > 1 ? migrationKey(a.database, a.sequence - 1) : undefined),
    onPredecessorFailed: heldByPredecessor,
  })
  .on(H.cancel, { enter: migrationDropped });

const backfillAttrs = z.object({ database: databaseName, table: z.string(), totalRows: z.number() });

const backfillQueued = H.state('Queued', 'pending');
const backfillDone = H.terminal('Done', 'success');
const backfillFailed = H.terminal('Failed', 'failure');
const backfillDropped = H.terminal('Dropped', 'neutral');

const backfill = H.kind('Backfill')
  .attributes(backfillAttrs)
  .states(backfillQueued, backfillDone, backfillFailed, backfillDropped)
  .key(a => `${a.database}.${a.table}`)
  .initial(backfillQueued);

const backfillBatch = H.command('backfill-batch')
  .input(z.object({ database: z.string(), table: z.string(), offset: z.number(), limit: z.number() }))
  .argv(input => ['backfill', input.database, input.table, `--offset=${input.offset}`, `--limit=${input.limit}`])
  .output(z.object({ rowsWritten: z.number() }))
  .runner(dbOps);

const batchRows = 10000;

const backfillFlow = H.flow('backfill')
  .input(backfillAttrs)
  .loop(
    'batches',
    flow => flow.step('batch', backfillBatch, ctx => ({
      database: ctx.unit.attributes.database,
      table: ctx.unit.attributes.table,
      offset: ctx.iteration * batchRows,
      limit: batchRows,
    }), { afterCrash: 'rerun', retry: { maxAttempts: 3, backoff: 'exponential', initialDelayMs: 5000 } }),
    {
      max: ctx => Math.ceil(ctx.unit.attributes.totalRows / batchRows),
      until: ctx => ctx.steps.batch.rowsWritten < batchRows,
    },
  )
  .exit('done');

const backfills = H.lane('backfills', backfill)
  .supply(H.operator)
  .handler(backfillFlow, { exits: { done: backfillDone } })
  .store(harnessStore)
  .retry({ maxAttempts: 2, backoff: 'exponential', initialDelayMs: 60000, exhausted: backfillFailed })
  .lease(unit => ({ resource: databases[unit.attributes.database], mode: 'shared' }))
  .on(H.cancel, { enter: backfillDropped });

const gpuHours = H.metric('gpu-hours-in-flight', H.when.step(evals, 'gpu')).amounts(event => [
  { amount: event.durationMs / 3600000 },
]);

const supervisor = claudeCode.supervisor('ml-supervisor', {
  port: H.slot.port(1),
  grants: [
    H.ops.workRead,
    H.ops.workCreate,
    H.ops.workCancel,
    H.ops.attemptsRecover,
    H.ops.telemetryRead,
  ],
});

export const harness = H.harness('ml-platform')
  .ledger(sqlite.ledger({ path: './.harness/ledger.sqlite' }))
  .lanes(evals, migrations, backfills)
  .metrics(gpuHours)
  .scheduler(
    H.scheduler('ml-scheduler')
      .standard(migrations, backfills, evals)
      .wip(evals, 2)
      .wip(backfills, 4)
      .admit(evals, ctx => ctx.metrics.total(gpuHours, { window: { calendar: 'day' } }).total < 200),
  )
  .clients(supervisor)
  .observers(
    markdown.board({ path: './.harness/board.md' }),
    markdown.telemetry({ path: './.harness/telemetry.md' }),
  );
